name: scan-grant-recommendations
description: Scan contacts and proactively suggest capability grants for contacts who have earned them through demonstrated trust patterns. Runs the LLM-judge recommendation engine. Files each pending recommendation as a task the principal owns (the coordinator raises it and routes the answer back), and returns a summary. Invoke on a schedule — not in response to user requests.

inputs.max_candidates: number? (max contacts to evaluate per run; default 20)
inputs.cadence_ceiling: number? (max new pending recommendations to create in one run; default 3)

outputs.skipped_existing: number (candidates skipped because a recommendation already exists)
outputs.skipped_judge: number (candidates where the judge explicitly declined to recommend)
outputs.skipped_errors: number (candidates skipped due to transport/parse failures — not judge decisions)
outputs.recommendations_created: array of { id, contact_id, contact_name, permission, reasoning } for each newly created recommendation
outputs.tasks_filed: number (principal-owned tasks filed this run, for new recommendations and any pending one still without a task)
outputs.task_failures: number (pending recommendations whose task could not be filed — retried next run)
